Nora (config): Quick sync 0min: we're adding a preview-only endpoint for mass flag edits (routing/quotas). Goal: let teams preview impact + get a rollout artifact ID. Need minimal telemetry hooks and safe defaults.

Evan (console): Sounds good. Minimal preview should return preview_id, snapshot_id, changed_keys list, and an estimated affected_rps number. UI: 2-col diff, small timeline, and export JSON. Dry-run only by default.

Sam (sre): Safety: max batch 500 keys. Anything >500 requires batching and ops approval. Canary options: 1% traffic for 30m with cooldown. Auto-pause if any shard sees >1% absolute error climb in first 15m.

Lina (telemetry): We'll capture a baseline snapshot (rps_1m, p95_latency, 5xx_rate, quota_util) and tag traces with X-Preview-Id for the first 20m after apply. Collector will emit compact preview_report every 60s: preview_id|metric:baseline:current:delta_pct.

Nora (config): Example API: POST /api/v1/config/preview {"changes":[{"path":"routes/global/route_by_cost","value":0.2}],"dry_run":true} -> response {preview_id, snapshot_id, estimate}. Console should store preview artifacts with TTL=30d and allow preserve.

Evan (console): We'll add a preview endpoint and artifact store. UI will show approvals required for large patches and a confirm modal listing auto-pause thresholds. Also show a small sparkline (optional) for high-impact keys.

Sam (sre): Add advisory lock tied to preview_id. If someone tries to apply while locked, return 409 with lock details. Also require runbook link for ops when patch touches >1000 tenants.

Lina (telemetry): For replay/staging: preview artifacts should include a replay hook so teams can run the same diff in staging with canned traffic and the X-Preview-Id tag. Collector PR incoming.

Nora (config): Action items: Evan -> POC endpoint + UI sketch by EOD Thu. Lina -> collector changes + report proto. Sam -> runbook snippet and batch thresholds. I'll own retention policy and API schema.

Evan (console): Ack. Will return example response: {"preview_id":"prv_1740555555", "snapshot_id":"snap_1740555500", "estimate":{"affected_keys":12,"est_rps_delta":0.02}}

deploy-bot: Reminder: config-service maintenance scheduled 2024-06-01 03:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid large operations then.

Nora (config): Please reference preview_id:1740555555 in PRs. Closing thread unless more concerns.

Evan (console): Will do.

Sam (sre): Thanks.

Lina (telemetry): On it.
